hero.headline_html:
Secure, Fast Payment Processing
at Every Terminal
hero.subheadline: Accept every payment method your customers use, including credit, debit, tap, chip, and mobile wallets, with hardware built for speed and security.

about.text_html: Your customers pay how they want, including credit cards, debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, contactless tap. A2Z credit card readers handle every payment method seamlessly, with fast processing speeds and security built in. No missed sales because you couldn't accept a payment type, and no security risks from outdated hardware.

features.description: Credit, debit, chip, tap, swipe, Apple Pay, Google Pay. Accept whatever your customer hands you.
